title: Spanish Sounds and Pronunciation Core Test
description: Core practice for Spanish vowels, syllables, stress, and accent marks.

questions.questionText: Which Spanish vowel is usually pronounced like "ee" in "see"?
questions.explanation: The Spanish vowel i is usually pronounced like ee in see.

questions.questionText: Which Spanish vowel is usually pronounced like "oo" in "food"?
questions.explanation: The Spanish vowel u is usually pronounced like oo in food.

questions.questionText: What do accent marks usually help show in Spanish?
options: that a word is a question
questions.explanation: Accent marks often show which syllable is stressed.

questions.questionText: Which word has a written accent mark?
questions.explanation: "Teléfono" has an accent mark over the first e.

questions.questionText: Which is the best beginner pronunciation habit?
options: Say Spanish vowels clearly and steadily.
Change vowels the way English does.
Try to speak fast before speaking clearly.
questions.correctAnswer: Say Spanish vowels clearly and steadily.
questions.explanation: Clear, steady vowels are a strong Spanish pronunciation habit.

questions.questionText: Which routine helps you read a new Spanish word aloud?
options: word -> vowel sounds -> syllables -> stress -> meaning
English spelling -> English stress -> Spanish meaning
questions.correctAnswer: word -> vowel sounds -> syllables -> stress -> meaning
questions.explanation: The tutorial gives this as the read-aloud routine.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about many Spanish letters and sounds?
options: They are usually more consistent than English.
They change randomly in every word.
They must be silent at the end of every word.
questions.correctAnswer: They are usually more consistent than English.
questions.explanation: Spanish pronunciation is often more consistent than English pronunciation.

questions.questionText: Why is speaking slowly useful when practicing Spanish pronunciation?
options: It helps you hear vowels and stress clearly.
It changes the meaning of every word.
questions.correctAnswer: It helps you hear vowels and stress clearly.
questions.explanation: Slower practice helps beginners control clear sounds before adding speed.
